title: DevvStream Corp. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-14
summary: DevvStream Corp. filed an 8-K on April 13, 2026, disclosing entry into a definitive Business Combination Agreement with XCF Global, Inc. and Southern Energy Renewables Inc. The transaction involves a multi-step merger structure including a domestication to Delaware, with DevvStream becoming a wholly-owned subsidiary of XCF.
key_points: DevvStream Corp. entered into a definitive Business Combination Agreement on April 13, 2026
The transaction involves DevvStream, XCF Global, and Southern Energy Renewables Inc
DevvStream will domesticate as a Delaware corporation prior to the mergers
DevvStream Merger Sub will merge into DevvStream, with DevvStream surviving as a wholly-owned subsidiary of XCF
Southern Merger Sub will merge into Southern, with Southern surviving as a wholly-owned subsidiary of XCF
Outstanding warrants, options, RSUs, and convertible notes will be assumed and converted into XCF Common Shares
